title: EvaluationGraph semantic contract versus local wire closure

sources.name: Autodesk AcDbEvalGraph reference
sources.observed: Describes directed acyclic dependency graphs for dynamic-block expressions and topological evaluation; if E1 depends on E2, edge E2->E1 represents the dependency.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Object model semantics, not a DXF/DWG wire-field map or local support result.

sources.name: Autodesk ObjectARX Graphs guide
sources.observed: States that AcDbEvalGraph has unique node IDs, hard-owns its nodes, checks cycles as edges change, and topologically sorts evaluation.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Semantic/API requirements; not serialized sentinel values or exact field placement.

sources.name: Autodesk Node Dependencies and Edges guide
sources.observed: Defines each edge by a start node and end node, with invertibility and additional directed/suppressed metadata exposed through edge-info APIs.
sources.evidenceCeiling: API-level edge semantics; not a DXF group-code interpretation.

sources.name: LibreDWG 0.13.4 OBJECTS manual and EVAL_Node API reference
sources.observed: Maps node id/flags/nextid/evalexpr to DXF groups 91/93/95/360; maps edge id/nextid/e1 to 92/93/94 with additional 91/92 integer fields.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer implementation/manual field crosswalk; not normative and does not settle every repeated integer's endpoint role or nextid termination.

sources.name: Local EvaluationGraph parser, writer, and tests
sources.observed: The DXF finalizer enforces field presence/cardinality; writer admission enforces version and vector size. Internal integers are emitted unchanged. Current focused vector contains one node id=1/nextid=2 and default-zero edge endpoint fields, while tests verify carrier capture, owner/expression closure and output framing rather than graph connectivity.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source/test coverage audit; does not prove the generated vector is invalid under the exact wire grammar or establish a current advertised semantic support claim.

conclusions: Current local EvaluationGraph evidence is wire capture and object/expression handle closure, not semantic dynamic-block graph validation.
Autodesk API documentation establishes unique node IDs, directed endpoints, and acyclic evaluation semantics, but does not specify the group-code mapping or nextid sentinel.
Treat internal node/edge reference checks as an implementation-readiness follow-up; do not add a defect ID or production guard until the exact serialized field mapping is confirmed.
No persistent fixtures or support claims are added. Findings/subplans remain 141/78, with J256/J260/J268/J284/J293/J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
actions: Resolve the EvaluationGraph DXF/DWG field map and nextid terminator through authoritative serialization evidence or an independently authored minimal trace.

Then add one scratch-generated two-node DAG and negative reference/duplicate/cycle controls to the existing ASCII/Binary selector; keep dynamic-block native behavior in the composed qualification gate.
